<script type="text/javascript">
var delay = (function(){
  var timer = 0;
  return function(callback, ms){
    clearTimeout (timer);
    timer = setTimeout(callback, ms);
  };
})();

jQuery.fn.OsLightbox = function( options ) {
	var settings = jQuery.extend({
		closeButton: true,
	}, options );
	let lightboxElement = jQuery(this);
	let lightboxText = settings.html;
	//console.log(lightboxElement);console.log(lightboxText);
	jQuery(lightboxElement).find('.os-lightbox-content').html(lightboxText);
	if(settings.closeButton) {
		jQuery('.os-lightbox-close').show();
	}
	//let windowWidth = jQuery(window).width();
	//let windowHeight = jQuery(window).width();
	jQuery(lightboxElement).fadeIn(600);
	return lightboxElement;
};

jQuery(document).ready(function() {

	var getUrlParameter = function getUrlParameter(sParam) {
    var sPageURL = window.location.search.substring(1),
      sURLVariables = sPageURL.split('&'),
      sParameterName,
      i;
    for (i = 0; i < sURLVariables.length; i++) {
      sParameterName = sURLVariables[i].split('=');
      if (sParameterName[0] === sParam) {
        return sParameterName[1] === undefined ? true : decodeURIComponent(sParameterName[1]);
      }
    }
    return false;
	};
	let urlState = getUrlParameter('state');
	let urlRegion = getUrlParameter('region');
	let urlMarket = getUrlParameter('market');
	let urlPropertytype = getUrlParameter('propertytype');

	if ((urlState) || (urlRegion) || (urlMarket) || (urlPropertytype)) {
		let state = '';
		let region = '';
		let market = '';
		let propertytype = '';
		if (urlState) {
			jQuery("select#state option").filter(function() {
				return jQuery(this).text() == urlState;
			}).attr('selected', true);
			state = urlState;
		}
		if (urlRegion) {
			jQuery("select#region option").filter(function() {
				return jQuery(this).text() == urlRegion;
			}).attr('selected', true);
			region = urlRegion;
		}
		if (urlMarket) {
			jQuery("select#market option").filter(function() {
				return jQuery(this).text() == urlMarket;
			}).attr('selected', true);
			market = urlMarket;
		}
		if (urlPropertytype) {
			jQuery("select#propertytype option").filter(function() {
				return jQuery(this).text() == urlPropertytype;
			}).attr('selected', true);
			propertytype = urlPropertytype;
		}
		fetchResults(state,region,market,propertytype);
		jQuery('#featuredProps').hide();
		jQuery('#searchedProps').show();
	}

  jQuery('#search').on('click',function() {
    let state = jQuery('#state option:selected').val();
		let region = jQuery('#region option:selected').val();
		let market = jQuery('#market option:selected').val();
		let propertytype = jQuery('#propertytype option:selected').val();
    fetchResults(state,region,market,propertytype);
		jQuery('#featuredProps').hide();
		jQuery('#searchedProps').show();
  });

	jQuery('.button.reset').on('click',function() {
		fetchResults('','','','');
		jQuery('#featuredProps').show();
		jQuery('#searchedProps').hide();
		jQuery('select#state').find('option:first').attr('selected', 'selected');
		jQuery('select#state').get(0).selectedIndex = 0;
		jQuery('select#region').find('option:first').attr('selected', 'selected');
		jQuery('select#region').get(0).selectedIndex = 0;
		jQuery('select#market').find('option:first').attr('selected', 'selected');
		jQuery('select#market').get(0).selectedIndex = 0;
		jQuery('select#propertytype').find('option:first').attr('selected', 'selected');
		jQuery('select#propertytype').get(0).selectedIndex = 0;
	});

	jQuery('body').on('click','.os-lightbox-close', function(e){
		e.preventDefault();
		jQuery('.os-lightbox').fadeOut(600);
	});
	jQuery('body').on('click','.os-lightbox .os-lightbox-overlay', function(e){
		e.preventDefault();
		jQuery('.os-lightbox').fadeOut(600);
	});



	jQuery('body').on('click','#searchresults .jet-posts__inner-box a', function(e){
		e.preventDefault();
		let pageURL = jQuery(this).attr('href');
		pageURL = '<iframe src="'+pageURL+'" scrolling="yes"></iframe>';
		jQuery('.os-lightbox-content').html(pageURL);
		jQuery('.os-lightbox').OsLightbox();
	});

	jQuery('body').on('click','#featuredProps .jet-posts__inner-box a', function(e){
		e.preventDefault();
		let pageURL = jQuery(this).attr('href');
		pageURL = '<iframe src="'+pageURL+'" scrolling="yes"></iframe>';
		jQuery('.os-lightbox-content').html(pageURL);
		jQuery('.os-lightbox').OsLightbox();
	});

});
function fetchResults(state,region,market,propertytype){
	jQuery.ajax({
		url: 'https://www.lxp.com/wp-admin/admin-ajax.php',
		type: 'post',
		data: { action: 'data_fetch',  state: state, region: region, market: market, propertytype: propertytype  },
    beforeSend: function() {jQuery('#searchedProps').html('<div class="loading"><i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin"></i></div>');},
		success: function(data) {jQuery('#searchedProps').html(data);}
	});
}
</script>
